text: Cambodia does not produce its own radish seed domestically — nearly all seed used is imported from other Asian countries, produced by various seed companies and evaluated for suitability under Cambodian growing conditions. Most imported varieties fall into two duration classes: short-duration/fast-maturing (ពូជស្រាល) and medium-duration (ពូជកណ្តាល); long-duration varieties are not well suited to Cambodia's climate. Named varieties recommended in the source: R 6197 and Kao Yuak 18 (Thailand, produced by East West Seed); a 55-day variety (Thailand, Chea Tai Seed, marketed under a wheel/gear logo); Everst F1 (Japan, produced by Takii Seed); and Wang Jian (Hong Kong, produced by Hong Kong Field Friend Agriculture Unite Co.), which has been popular in the Cambodian market since around 2001.
